rubrics_metrics.name: Home Magazine subscription and premium terms (1863)
rubrics_metrics.description: Yearly terms, in advance: 1 copy Home Magazine (and one of the premium plates), $2.00; 2 copies (and one of the premium plates to getter-up of Club), $8.00; 3 copies $4.00; 4 copies $5.00; 8 copies (and an extra copy of Magazine, and one premium plate to getter-up of Club), $10.00; 12 copies two [premium plates] $15.00; 17 copies $20.00. Each single subscriber who pays $2 is entitled to one of the premium plates. In ordering premiums, three red stamps must be sent, in every case, to pay the cost of mailing each premium. It is not required that all the Subscribers to a Club be at the same Post Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscriptions must be paid in advance; clubbing rates grant premiums to the club getter-up; mailing premiums require three red stamps; club members may be at different post offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Home Magazine clubbing bundle offers
rubrics_metrics.description: CLUBBING: Home Magazine and Godey's Lady's Book, one year, $3.50. Home Magazine and Harper's Magazine, one year, $8.50. Home Magazine and Saturday Evening Post, $3.00.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific combined-subscription package prices are offered for bundling Home Magazine with other periodicals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continental Monthly subscription, postage and premium offers
rubrics_metrics.description: TERMS TO CLUBS: Two copies for one year, Five dollars. Three copies for one year, Six dollars. Six copies for one year, Eleven dollars. Eleven copies for one year, Twenty dollars. Twenty copies for one year, Thirty-six dollars. PAID IN ADVANCE. Postage, Thirty-six cents a year, TO BE PAID BY THE SUBSCRIBER. SINGLE COPIES. Three Dollars a year, IN ADVANCE.--Postage paid by the Publisher. As inducement to new subscribers: Any person remitting $3, in advance, will receive the Magazine from July, 1862, to January, 1864 ... Any person remitting $4.50, will receive the Magazine from its commencement, January, 1862, to January, 1864 ... Premium subscribers to pay their own postage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Club rates require advance payment; subscribers pay a stated annual postage; single-copy annual subscriptions are paid in advance and postage paid by publisher; promotional premium offers are tied to specific remittance amounts and may require subscribers to pay postage on premiums.

rubrics_metrics.name: Illinois Central Railroad land sale: description and payment schedule on long credit
rubrics_metrics.description: The Illinois Central Railroad Company offer, ON LONG CREDIT, the beautiful and fertile PRAIRIE LANDS... 1,200,000 Acres, in Farms of 40, 80, 120, 160 Acres and upwards ... PRICES AND TERMS OF PAYMENT--ON LONG CREDIT. 80 acres at $10 per acre with interest at 6 per ct. annually on the following terms: Cash payment $48.00; Payment in one year $48.00; in two years $48.00; in three years $48.00; in four years $236.00; in five years $224.00; in six years $212.00; in seven years $300.00. 40 acres, at $10.00 per acre; Cash payment $24.00; Payment in one year $24.00; ... in four years $118.00; in five years $112.00; in six years $106.00; in seven years $150.00.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Land purchases are offered with explicit long-credit installment schedules and per-acre pricing; prospective buyers should use the stated payment timetable when evaluating affordability and contractual terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premium ordering postal requirement (three red stamps)
rubrics_metrics.description: In ordering premiums, three red stamps must be sent, in every case, to pay the cost of mailing each premium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit procedural requirement for receiving advertised premiums; failure to include the stamps likely results in no premium delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premia/club-getter rules (who receives premium)
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain premium plates are given to the 'getter-up of Club' (e.g., 2 copies and one premium plate to getter-up of Club). Each single subscriber who pays $2 is entitled to one of the premium plates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Club organizers (the getter-up) receive designated extra premiums; individual subscribers who pay the single-subscriber price receive a premium plate as indicated.
